book.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics: Probability & Statistics 1
book.author: Dean Chalmers
book.policy: Book informs concepts and teaching structure; notes, numerical examples and short checks are independently written. No textbook exercises or artwork are copied.

source_scope.unselected_note: Selection is a 50-family chapter bank, not a claim that all 158 original records have been converted.

syllabus.cross_link: Section 5.2 counting selections is explicitly tagged where combination notation is used. Finite stopping and transition questions use elementary trees; no Markov-chain or infinite-distribution theory is required.
syllabus.editorial_blocks: The five working blocks are an editorial organisation of the chapter, not five separate official syllabus sections.

conventions.probabilities: Give exact fractions unless an alternative exact form is requested. Equivalent exact rational forms are accepted.
conventions.randomness: Uniform random selection is stated explicitly where elementary outcomes are equiprobable.
conventions.independence: Only assume independence when it is stated or proved from the model.
conventions.complements: A prime denotes the complement, e.g. A'.
conventions.solutions: Diagrams supplied with this package are solution aids; they are not to be sent to the learner before answer release.

sourceCheckSpecifications: Retained privately as specifications only; written reasoning, exact probability interpretation and method marks use the existing manual/teacher workflow.
